blocks.zh: 廠房設施與設備要求
blocks.en: Facility and Equipment Requirements

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 掌握 §211.42 廠房設計與建構要求，特別理解無菌操作區域的法規基礎與空間分隔的強制要求
blocks.en: Master the facility design and construction requirements of §211.42, with particular attention to the regulatory basis for aseptic processing areas and the mandatory requirement for spatial separation

blocks.zh: 解析 §211.46 空調通風系統（HVAC）要求，連結 HEPA 過濾、壓差控制與 ISO 14644 潔淨室標準
blocks.en: Analyze the ventilation and air-handling (HVAC) requirements of §211.46 and link them to HEPA filtration, pressure differential control and ISO 14644 cleanroom standards

blocks.zh: 理解 §211.63/211.65 設備設計與建造要求，掌握 GMP 設備選材標準（316L 不銹鋼、表面粗糙度）及設備確認 IQ/OQ/PQ 框架
blocks.en: Understand the equipment design and construction requirements of §211.63/211.65, including GMP material-selection standards (316L stainless steel, surface roughness) and the IQ/OQ/PQ equipment qualification framework

blocks.zh: 逐條分析 §211.67 設備清潔與維護要求，連結清潔驗證概念（MACO 計算、殘留限度）及 Clean/Dirty Hold Time 管理
blocks.en: Work through the equipment cleaning and maintenance requirements of §211.67 clause by clause, and connect them to cleaning validation concepts (MACO calculation, residue limits) and Clean/Dirty Hold Time management

blocks.zh: 掌握 §211.72 過濾器要求，理解無菌製程中 0.22 µm 除菌過濾器完整性測試的法規依據與技術方法
blocks.en: Master the filter requirements of §211.72 and understand the regulatory basis and technical methods for integrity testing of 0.22 µm sterilizing filters in aseptic processing

blocks.zh: 識別本章各條款最常見的 FDA 483 觀察項目與警告信引用模式
blocks.en: Recognize the most common FDA 483 observations and Warning Letter citation patterns for each provision in this chapter

blocks.zh: 2.1 §211.42 — Design and Construction Features: The Sterile Drug Facility Framework 2.1 §211.42 — 設計與建造特性：無菌藥品廠房架構
blocks.en: 2.1 §211.42 — Design and Construction Features: The Sterile Drug Facility Framework

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：§211.42 是無菌廠房的法規基石
blocks.en: Core Concept: §211.42 Is the Regulatory Cornerstone of a Sterile Facility

blocks.zh: §211.42 是整個無菌藥品製造廠房設計的 CGMP 法律基礎。架構分三層：
blocks.en: §211.42 is the CGMP legal foundation for the design of the entire sterile drug manufacturing facility. It has a three-tier structure:

blocks.zh: 第一層（a）： 廠房整體適合性——尺寸、結構、位置，服務於清潔、維護和正確操作。
blocks.en: Tier 1 (a): Overall suitability of the facility - size, construction and location must support cleaning, maintenance and proper operations.

blocks.zh: 第二層（b）： 流程設計——物料、容器、標籤的流向設計要防止污染和混淆。這是「單向流」設計原則的法規來源。
blocks.en: Tier 2 (b): Flow design - the flow of materials, containers and labeling must be designed to prevent contamination and mix-ups. This is the regulatory source of the "unidirectional flow" design principle.

blocks.zh: 第三層（c）： 操作分隔——最詳細的要求，列出 10 類必須有獨立或明確區域的操作，其中 (c)(10) 專門針對無菌加工操作。
blocks.en: Tier 3 (c): Separation of operations - the most detailed requirement, listing 10 types of operations that must have separate or defined areas; (c)(10) specifically addresses aseptic processing operations.

blocks.zh: 483 高頻觀察項目：「隔離不足 (Inadequate Separation)」
blocks.en: High-Frequency 483 Observation: "Inadequate Separation"

blocks.zh: 最常見的 §211.42 483 缺陷：
blocks.en: The most common §211.42 483 deficiencies:

blocks.zh: 待檢品（Quarantine）與放行品未物理分隔，僅以標示區分
blocks.en: Quarantined material and released material are not physically separated and are distinguished by labeling only

blocks.zh: 退貨品與未開封庫存放置於同一區域
blocks.en: Returned goods and unopened stock are held in the same area

blocks.zh: 無菌灌裝區與低級別準備區之間無足夠氣鎖（airlock）設計
blocks.en: Insufficient airlock design between the aseptic filling area and lower-grade preparation areas

blocks.zh: 廢棄物通道與物料進入通道交叉
blocks.en: Waste routes cross material entry routes

blocks.zh: 實驗室（控制操作）與生產區無實際隔離
blocks.en: The laboratory (control operations) is not actually separated from the production area

blocks.zh: §211.42(d) 盤尼西林交叉污染： 盤尼西林（青黴素）的設施分隔要求是絕對的——不允許在同一廠房（即使不同時間）生產盤尼西林和非盤尼西林人用藥品。這是業界最嚴格的分隔要求之一，因殘留量極低即可導致嚴重過敏反應。
blocks.en: §211.42(d) Penicillin cross-contamination: The facility separation requirement for penicillin is absolute - penicillin and non-penicillin human drug products may not be manufactured in the same facility, even at different times. This is one of the strictest separation requirements in the industry, because even extremely low residue levels can cause severe allergic reactions.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家注射劑 CDMO 的灌裝區域使用「限制進入屏障系統（RABS）」替代傳統 ISO 5 潔淨室。§211.42(c)(10) 的哪些要求仍然適用？RABS 如何滿足 HEPA 和正壓要求？
blocks.en: An injectables CDMO uses a restricted access barrier system (RABS) in its filling area in place of a conventional ISO 5 cleanroom. Which §211.42(c)(10) requirements still apply? How does the RABS meet the HEPA and positive pressure requirements?

blocks.zh: §211.42(b) 要求防止「mix-ups」（混淆）的流向設計。如果一個廠房的物料進入路線與廢棄物出口路線交叉，這是否違反 §211.42(b)？應如何改善？
blocks.en: §211.42(b) requires flow design that prevents "mix-ups". If a facility's material entry route crosses its waste exit route, does this violate §211.42(b)? How should it be improved?

blocks.zh: §211.42(c)(10) 與 ISO 14644、FDA 無菌指南的層次關係
blocks.en: The Relationship of §211.42(c)(10) to ISO 14644 and the FDA Aseptic Guidance

blocks.zh: §211.42(c)(10) 是 CGMP 的強制要求（法規），而 ISO 14644 和 FDA 2004 Aseptic Guidance 是技術標準（非強制但代表業界最佳實踐）。
blocks.en: §211.42(c)(10) is a mandatory CGMP requirement (regulation), whereas ISO 14644 and the FDA 2004 Aseptic Guidance are technical standards (not mandatory, but representing industry best practice).

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 將無菌生產環境分為 A（ISO 5）、B（ISO 5 背景）、C（ISO 7）、D（ISO 8），比 §211.42(c)(10) 更具體，是 FDA 查廠人員常用的技術參考基礎。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) classifies the aseptic manufacturing environment into grades A (ISO 5), B (ISO 5 background), C (ISO 7) and D (ISO 8). It is more specific than §211.42(c)(10) and is a technical reference commonly used by FDA investigators.

blocks.zh: 2.2 §211.46 — Ventilation, Air Filtration, Air Heating and Cooling 2.2 §211.46 — 通風、空氣過濾、加熱與冷卻
blocks.en: 2.2 §211.46 — Ventilation, Air Filtration, Air Heating and Cooling

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究（Smoke Studies / Air Visualization）
blocks.en: Smoke Studies (Air Visualization)

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究是驗證 HVAC 氣流模式的技術工具，其法規依據正是 §211.46(b) 和 §211.42(c)(10)。目的：
blocks.en: Smoke studies are the technical tool for verifying HVAC airflow patterns, and their regulatory basis is §211.46(b) and §211.42(c)(10). Objectives:

blocks.zh: 確認關鍵區域為單向流（Unidirectional Airflow, UDAF）——空氣從 ISO 5 區向外流，而非渦流
blocks.en: Confirm that critical areas have unidirectional airflow (UDAF) - air flows outward from the ISO 5 zone rather than forming eddies

blocks.zh: 確認氣鎖（airlock）的氣流方向正確（淨氣鎖 vs. 髒氣鎖）
blocks.en: Confirm that the airflow direction of airlocks is correct (clean airlock vs. dirty airlock)

blocks.zh: 確認人員和設備的動態引入不破壞 HEPA 覆蓋氣流
blocks.en: Confirm that the dynamic introduction of personnel and equipment does not disrupt the HEPA-covered airflow

blocks.zh: 識別「死角」（dead zones）——低氣流速度區域，微生物污染風險高
blocks.en: Identify "dead zones" - areas of low air velocity with a high risk of microbial contamination

blocks.zh: FDA 和 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 均要求在動態條件（模擬最差情況操作）下進行煙霧研究，並錄影留存。
blocks.en: Both FDA and PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) expect smoke studies to be performed under dynamic conditions (simulating worst-case operations) and recorded on video for retention.

blocks.zh: §211.46(d) 盤尼西林 HVAC 完全分離
blocks.en: §211.46(d) Completely Separate HVAC for Penicillin

blocks.zh: §211.46(d) 要求盤尼西林的空調系統與其他人用藥品完全分開。這是「廠房分隔（§211.42(d)）+ 空調分隔（§211.46(d)）」的雙重要求。即使廠房分開，若共用空調排放或進氣，仍違反 §211.46(d)。歷史上曾有患者因注射用藥品受盤尼西林交叉污染而發生嚴重過敏反應的案例，是此雙重要求的立法背景。
blocks.en: §211.46(d) requires that the air-handling systems for penicillin be completely separate from those for other human drug products. This is a dual requirement: facility separation (§211.42(d)) plus HVAC separation (§211.46(d)). Even if the buildings are separate, sharing HVAC exhaust or supply air still violates §211.46(d). There have been historical cases in which patients suffered severe allergic reactions after injectable products were cross-contaminated with penicillin, and these cases are the legislative background to this dual requirement.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的 ISO 7 配液間的壓差感測器在 OQ 期間顯示對外部走廊的壓差僅有 7 Pa（規格要求 ≥10 Pa）。這是 §211.46(b) 的缺陷嗎？需要如何處理？
blocks.en: During OQ at a CDMO, the differential pressure sensor in an ISO 7 compounding room shows a differential of only 7 Pa relative to the outer corridor (specification: ≥10 Pa). Is this a §211.46(b) deficiency? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: §211.46(c) 提到「當適當時（when appropriate）」使用空氣過濾。對於無菌注射劑的灌裝室，這是必要的還是建議性的？為什麼？
blocks.en: §211.46(c) refers to air filtration "when appropriate". For a sterile injectable filling room, is this mandatory or advisory? Why?

blocks.zh: ISO 5 灌裝室的動態粒子監測（≥0.5 µm）超出行動限度（Action Limit: >1 個/ft³）。此時正在進行灌裝的批次應如何處置？需要啟動哪些調查？
blocks.en: Dynamic particle monitoring (≥0.5 µm) in an ISO 5 filling room exceeds the action limit (Action Limit: >1 particle/ft³). How should the batch currently being filled be handled? What investigations must be initiated?

blocks.zh: §211.46 與 HVAC 驗證的連結
blocks.en: The Link Between §211.46 and HVAC Validation

blocks.zh: §211.46 是 HVAC 系統 GMP 合規的法規基礎。一套完整的無菌廠房 HVAC 驗證流程如下：
blocks.en: §211.46 is the regulatory basis for GMP compliance of HVAC systems. A complete HVAC qualification process for a sterile facility is as follows:

blocks.zh: 壓差梯度設計（Pressure Cascade）
blocks.en: Pressure Cascade Design

blocks.zh: 壓差梯度是防止低等級區域空氣向高等級區域流動的關鍵設計。以注射劑灌裝廠為例：
blocks.en: The pressure cascade is the key design feature that prevents air from lower-grade areas flowing into higher-grade areas. Taking an injectable filling facility as an example:

blocks.zh: 相鄰等級之間的最小壓差建議：10–15 Pa（依據 PIC/S Annex 1 和 ISO 14644-4 的工程建議）。§211.46 本身不規定具體數字，但 FDA 查廠時會參考 FDA 無菌指南和 PIC/S 標準。
blocks.en: Recommended minimum pressure differential between adjacent grades: 10–15 Pa (based on the engineering recommendations of PIC/S Annex 1 and ISO 14644-4). §211.46 itself does not specify numerical values, but during inspections FDA refers to the FDA Aseptic Guidance and PIC/S standards.

blocks.zh: 環境監測（EM）系統：§211.42(c)(10)(iv) 的技術實現
blocks.en: Environmental Monitoring (EM) System: Technical Implementation of §211.42(c)(10)(iv)

blocks.zh: §211.42(c)(10)(iv) 要求「環境條件監測系統」——在無菌製造中，環境監測計劃（Environmental Monitoring Program, EMP）是此要求的具體實現：
blocks.en: §211.42(c)(10)(iv) requires a "system for monitoring environmental conditions". In aseptic manufacturing, the Environmental Monitoring Program (EMP) is the concrete implementation of this requirement:

blocks.zh: 環境監測結果超出警戒限度（Alert Limit）時需要趨勢調查；超出行動限度（Action Limit）時需要正式偏差調查和 CAPA。FDA 查廠時常審查 EM 趨勢數據和 OOT（超出趨勢）調查記錄。
blocks.en: Results exceeding the Alert Limit require trend investigation; results exceeding the Action Limit require a formal deviation investigation and CAPA. During inspections FDA often reviews EM trend data and OOT (out-of-trend) investigation records.

blocks.zh: 2.3 §211.63 & §211.65 — Equipment Design, Size, Location and Construction 2.3 §211.63 & §211.65 — 設備設計、尺寸、位置與建造
blocks.en: 2.3 §211.63 & §211.65 — Equipment Design, Size, Location and Construction

blocks.zh: §211.65(b) 潤滑劑與輔助物質的 GMP 管理
blocks.en: §211.65(b) GMP Control of Lubricants and Ancillary Substances

blocks.zh: §211.65(b) 要求潤滑劑、冷卻液等輔助物質不能接觸藥品，或接觸後不能改變 SISPQ。在注射劑製造中的實際影響：
blocks.en: §211.65(b) requires that lubricants, coolants and other ancillary substances must not contact the drug product, or, if they do, must not alter its SISPQ (safety, identity, strength, purity and quality). The practical implications in injectable manufacturing are:

blocks.zh: 灌裝機零件潤滑： 必須使用食品級或藥用級潤滑劑（USP 白礦物油），並建立潤滑計劃和記錄
blocks.en: Lubrication of filling machine parts: Food-grade or pharmaceutical-grade lubricants (USP white mineral oil) must be used, and a lubrication plan and records must be established

blocks.zh: 矽油（Silicone oil）： 注射器活塞潤滑劑，屬於「可接受的添加物」，但需在 NDA/ANDA 中申報，且有容器/密封系統相容性測試要求
blocks.en: Silicone oil: Used as a syringe plunger lubricant, it is an "acceptable additive" but must be declared in the NDA/ANDA, and container/closure system compatibility testing is required

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣品質： 與藥液接觸的壓縮空氣需符合 ISO 8573 的油份、水份、粒子標準（通常 Class 1.2.1 用於關鍵接觸點）
blocks.en: Compressed air quality: Compressed air that contacts the drug solution must meet the oil, water and particulate standards of ISO 8573 (typically Class 1.2.1 for critical contact points)

blocks.zh: 483 高頻觀察：設備設計缺陷
blocks.en: High-Frequency 483 Observations: Equipment Design Deficiencies

blocks.zh: 設備接觸面存在死角（dead legs）或難以清潔的幾何形狀，無 3D 評估文件
blocks.en: Equipment product-contact surfaces have dead legs or hard-to-clean geometries, with no 3D assessment documentation

blocks.zh: 橡皮管或塑膠軟管未進行浸出物（extractables/leachables, E&L）評估
blocks.en: Rubber or plastic hoses have not been assessed for extractables/leachables (E&L)

blocks.zh: 設備安裝位置無法進行充分維護或清潔目視確認
blocks.en: Equipment is installed in a location that does not allow adequate maintenance or visual confirmation of cleaning

blocks.zh: 潤滑劑使用未記錄或使用非食品/藥用級潤滑劑
blocks.en: Lubricant use is not recorded, or non-food-grade/non-pharmaceutical-grade lubricants are used

blocks.zh: 設備確認文件缺失（無 DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ）或 OQ 未涵蓋最差情況操作條件
blocks.en: Equipment qualification documentation is missing (no DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ), or OQ does not cover worst-case operating conditions

blocks.zh: 一台新購入的無菌灌裝機（Vial Filling Machine）完成 IQ，但 OQ 只在正常速度（中速）下測試了灌裝精度，未測試低速和高速。這符合 §211.63 的「適當設計和尺寸以便操作」要求嗎？如果 FDA 查廠時發現此問題，可能引用什麼條款？
blocks.en: A newly purchased aseptic vial filling machine has completed IQ, but OQ tested filling accuracy only at normal (medium) speed, not at low and high speeds. Does this meet the §211.63 requirement for "appropriate design and size for operations"? If FDA finds this during an inspection, which provisions might it cite?

blocks.zh: 一條工藝管路中有一段 Dead Leg 長度為管徑的 5 倍（5D），已超過 ASME BPE 的 3D 建議。製造商提出可以增加定期清潔頻率作為補償措施。這個方法從 §211.63 和 §211.65 的角度是否可接受？需要什麼驗證支持？
blocks.en: A process pipeline contains a dead leg 5 times the pipe diameter (5D), exceeding the 3D recommendation of ASME BPE. The manufacturer proposes increasing the frequency of periodic cleaning as a compensating measure. Is this approach acceptable from the standpoint of §211.63 and §211.65? What validation support is needed?

blocks.zh: 設備確認（Equipment Qualification）：§211.63 到 IQ/OQ/PQ 的完整路徑
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification: The Complete Path from §211.63 to IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: §211.63 要求設備「設計適當、尺寸充分、位置合適」——這三個要求直接對應設備確認的四個階段：
blocks.en: §211.63 requires equipment to be "of appropriate design, adequate size, and suitably located" - these three requirements map directly onto the four phases of equipment qualification:

blocks.zh: 灌裝機 OQ 協議的典型測試項目（實務範例）：
blocks.en: Typical test items in a filling machine OQ protocol (practical example):

blocks.zh: 灌裝精度測試：各灌裝頭在低、中、高速下的重量偏差（±2% 典型規格）
blocks.en: Filling accuracy test: weight variation of each filling head at low, medium and high speed (typical specification ±2%)

blocks.zh: 灌裝量重現性（RSD ≤ 1.0%）在整個班次的穩定性
blocks.en: Fill volume reproducibility (RSD ≤ 1.0%) and stability across the entire shift

blocks.zh: 機器速度確認（最低速 / 正常速 / 最高速）
blocks.en: Machine speed verification (minimum / normal / maximum speed)

blocks.zh: 氮氣覆蓋流量確認（對氧敏感產品）
blocks.en: Nitrogen overlay flow verification (for oxygen-sensitive products)

blocks.zh: 自動拒瓶系統功能驗證（重量超出規格時的拒瓶機制）
blocks.en: Functional verification of the automatic reject system (rejection mechanism when weight is out of specification)

blocks.zh: 緊急停機功能測試
blocks.en: Emergency stop function test

blocks.zh: 316L 不銹鋼與注射劑設備選材
blocks.en: 316L Stainless Steel and Material Selection for Injectable Equipment

blocks.zh: §211.65(a) 要求接觸面「非反應性、非添加性、非吸附性」——在注射劑製造中，316L 不銹鋼是接觸面的行業標準選材：
blocks.en: §211.65(a) requires product-contact surfaces to be "non-reactive, non-additive, and non-absorptive". In injectable manufacturing, 316L stainless steel is the industry-standard material for product-contact surfaces:

blocks.zh: 表面粗糙度（Ra 值）實務指引（ASME BPE-2019）：
blocks.en: Practical guidance on surface roughness (Ra values) (ASME BPE-2019):

blocks.zh: 配液槽、過濾器殼體（接觸 API）：Ra ≤ 0.8 µm（SF4 等級）
blocks.en: Compounding tanks and filter housings (contacting API): Ra ≤ 0.8 µm (SF4 grade)

blocks.zh: WFI 儲存和分配系統：Ra ≤ 0.5 µm（SF3 等級）
blocks.en: WFI storage and distribution system: Ra ≤ 0.5 µm (SF3 grade)

blocks.zh: 一般工藝配管（無菌區）：Ra ≤ 0.8 µm
blocks.en: General process piping (aseptic area): Ra ≤ 0.8 µm

blocks.zh: Dead Legs（死腿）管理： §211.63 要求「位置合適，便於清潔」——管路系統中 Dead Leg（末端無流動的管段）是微生物滋生的高風險區。ASME BPE 建議 Dead Leg 長度不超過管徑的 3 倍（3D rule）。FDA 查廠時可能要求提供 P&ID（管道和儀表圖）確認無不合規 Dead Leg。
blocks.en: Dead leg management: §211.63 requires equipment to be "suitably located to facilitate cleaning" - a dead leg in a piping system (a branch with no flow at its end) is a high-risk area for microbial growth. ASME BPE recommends that dead leg length not exceed 3 times the pipe diameter (the 3D rule). During inspections FDA may ask for P&IDs (piping and instrumentation diagrams) to confirm there are no non-compliant dead legs.

blocks.zh: E&L（浸出物/萃出物）評估：§211.65 的科學實踐
blocks.en: E&L (Extractables/Leachables) Assessment: The Scientific Practice Behind §211.65

blocks.zh: §211.65(a) 的「非添加性」要求在現代注射劑開發中透過 E&L（Extractables and Leachables）評估系統化實現：
blocks.en: The "non-additive" requirement of §211.65(a) is implemented systematically in modern injectable development through E&L (Extractables and Leachables) assessment:

blocks.zh: E&L 評估的觸發條件（依 USP <661.1> 和 ICH Q3E）：
blocks.en: Triggers for E&L assessment (per USP <661.1> and ICH Q3E):

blocks.zh: 所有注射劑的直接接觸包材（容器/密封系統）
blocks.en: All direct-contact packaging components (container/closure systems) of injectable products

blocks.zh: 新型設備接觸材料（如新型彈性體、塑膠軟管）引入時
blocks.en: Introduction of new equipment contact materials (e.g., new elastomers, plastic hoses)

blocks.zh: 使用溫度、清潔劑或滅菌方法發生重大變更時
blocks.en: Significant changes in use temperature, cleaning agents or sterilization method

blocks.zh: 供應商材料配方變更時（即使尺寸和外觀未變）
blocks.en: Changes in the supplier's material formulation (even if dimensions and appearance are unchanged)

blocks.zh: 安全閾值（Safety Concern Threshold, SCT）： 依 PQRI 2006 指南，注射劑中 leachable 的 SCT 為 1.5 µg/day——超過此值的化合物需要進行毒理學評估。
blocks.en: Safety Concern Threshold (SCT): According to the PQRI 2006 recommendations, the SCT for leachables in injectable products is 1.5 µg/day - compounds above this value require toxicological assessment.

blocks.zh: 2.4 §211.67 — Equipment Cleaning and Maintenance 2.4 §211.67 — 設備清潔與維護
blocks.en: 2.4 §211.67 — Equipment Cleaning and Maintenance

blocks.zh: §211.67(b)(4)–(6)：批次識別移除與清潔後保護
blocks.en: §211.67(b)(4)–(6): Removal of Batch Identification and Protection After Cleaning

blocks.zh: (b)(4) 移除批次識別： 上一批次的標識必須在清潔前或清潔過程中完全移除（包括設備上的手寫標記、貼紙、標牌）。防止清潔後設備被錯誤識別為其他批次。
blocks.en: (b)(4) Removal of batch identification: The identification of the previous batch must be completely removed before or during cleaning (including handwritten marks, stickers and tags on the equipment). This prevents cleaned equipment from being mistakenly identified as belonging to another batch.

blocks.zh: (b)(5) 清潔後防污染保護： 清潔好的設備在使用前需保護，防止被再污染。例：配液槽清潔完成後用蓋子密封，不暴露在環境中超過 CHT 限度。
blocks.en: (b)(5) Protection against contamination after cleaning: Cleaned equipment must be protected before use to prevent recontamination. Example: after a compounding tank is cleaned, it is sealed with a lid and not exposed to the environment beyond the CHT limit.

blocks.zh: (b)(6) 使用前清潔目視確認： 每次使用前需目視檢查清潔狀態，並記錄。這是清潔驗證的輔助控制，不能取代驗證本身。
blocks.en: (b)(6) Visual inspection of cleanliness before use: The cleanliness status must be visually checked and recorded before each use. This is a supplementary control to cleaning validation and cannot replace the validation itself.

blocks.zh: 設備使用日誌（Equipment Use Log）：§211.182 的記錄要求
blocks.en: Equipment Use Log: Record Requirements of §211.182

blocks.zh: §211.67(c) 引用 §211.182，要求保存清潔、消毒、維護記錄。完整的設備使用日誌通常包含：
blocks.en: §211.67(c) refers to §211.182, which requires that cleaning, sanitizing and maintenance records be kept. A complete equipment use log typically includes:

blocks.zh: 設備識別碼（ID）和名稱
blocks.en: Equipment identification number (ID) and name

blocks.zh: 使用日期、批號、產品名稱
blocks.en: Date of use, batch number and product name

blocks.zh: 清潔方法編號（SOP 編號）、清潔執行人簽名和日期
blocks.en: Cleaning method number (SOP number) and the signature and date of the person who performed the cleaning

blocks.zh: 清潔後使用前目視確認記錄（簽名、日期）
blocks.en: Record of visual verification after cleaning and before use (signature, date)

blocks.zh: 清潔後有效存放期到期日（CHT 截止日期）
blocks.en: Expiry date of the post-cleaning hold period (CHT deadline)

blocks.zh: 維護記錄（定期保養、異常修理）
blocks.en: Maintenance records (preventive maintenance, unscheduled repairs)

blocks.zh: 設備日誌是 FDA 查廠最常被要求調閱的文件之一，缺失或不完整是高頻 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: Equipment logs are among the documents FDA most often asks to review during inspections, and missing or incomplete logs are a high-frequency 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 微生物監控連結：USP <1116> 與交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Microbiological Monitoring Link: USP <1116> and Cross-Contamination Risk

blocks.zh: §211.67(a) 要求防止「污染」——對於無菌製造設備，微生物污染和化學交叉污染是雙重主要風險。
blocks.en: §211.67(a) requires that equipment be cleaned to prevent "contamination" - for aseptic manufacturing equipment, microbial contamination and chemical cross-contamination are the two principal risks.

blocks.zh: USP <1116>（微生物控制和監測環境）的連結：
blocks.en: Link to USP <1116> (Microbiological Control and Monitoring of Aseptic Processing Environments):

blocks.zh: ISO 5/7/8 環境的行動限度（Action Limits）和警戒限度（Alert Limits）建議
blocks.en: Recommended Action Limits and Alert Limits for ISO 5/7/8 environments

blocks.zh: 設備表面接觸碟（Contact Plates / Replicate Organism Detection and Counting, RODAC）和棉棒採樣方法指引
blocks.en: Guidance on equipment surface sampling with contact plates (Replicate Organism Detection and Counting, RODAC) and swabs

blocks.zh: 清潔後設備的生物負荷（Bioburden）評估方法
blocks.en: Methods for assessing the bioburden of equipment after cleaning

blocks.zh: 交叉污染（Carryover Contamination）風險管理： 共用設備最大的 GMP 風險是前一產品的殘留污染下一產品。高風險情境包括：
blocks.en: Cross-contamination (carryover contamination) risk management: The greatest GMP risk of shared equipment is residue of the previous product contaminating the next. High-risk scenarios include:

blocks.zh: 強效藥物（Highly Potent Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, HPAPI）：PDE 極低（ng/day 等級），MACO 值極小，清潔驗證要求極嚴格
blocks.en: Highly potent active pharmaceutical ingredients (HPAPI): very low PDE (ng/day level), very small MACO values, and extremely stringent cleaning validation requirements

blocks.zh: 致敏性物質（盤尼西林、β-lactam）：需要專用設備，不允許共用
blocks.en: Sensitizing substances (penicillin, β-lactams): dedicated equipment is required and sharing is not permitted

blocks.zh: 生物製劑（生物鹼、蛋白質）：TOC 分析往往是主要殘留檢測方法
blocks.en: Biologics (alkaloids, proteins): TOC analysis is often the main residue detection method

blocks.zh: 當設備清潔 SOP 驗證數據（§211.67）與環境監測趨勢數據（USP <1116>）結合分析時，能全面評估無菌操作的微生物和化學污染控制狀態。
blocks.en: When equipment cleaning SOP validation data (§211.67) is analyzed together with environmental monitoring trend data (USP <1116>), the state of microbial and chemical contamination control in aseptic operations can be assessed comprehensively.

blocks.zh: 483/警告信高頻引用：§211.67 缺陷模式
blocks.en: 483/Warning Letter High-Frequency Citations: §211.67 Deficiency Patterns

blocks.zh: 清潔 SOP 缺乏足夠細節（「用水清洗」但未規定溫度、流速、時間）
blocks.en: Cleaning SOP lacks sufficient detail ("rinse with water" without specifying temperature, flow rate or time)

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證未涵蓋所有共用設備，或驗證數據不支持商業生產規模
blocks.en: Cleaning validation does not cover all shared equipment, or validation data do not support commercial production scale

blocks.zh: 超過清潔後最大存放時間（CHT）後仍使用設備，無重新清潔記錄
blocks.en: Equipment is used after the maximum clean hold time (CHT) has been exceeded, with no record of re-cleaning

blocks.zh: 設備日誌中清潔確認記錄缺失或不完整
blocks.en: Cleaning verification records in the equipment log are missing or incomplete

blocks.zh: 清潔劑供應商或配方更換後未重新驗證清潔方法
blocks.en: Cleaning method not revalidated after a change of cleaning agent supplier or formulation

blocks.zh: Dedicated（專用）設備標識缺失——共用設備被誤認為專用，跳過清潔驗證
blocks.en: Missing identification of dedicated equipment - shared equipment is mistaken for dedicated equipment and cleaning validation is skipped

blocks.zh: HPAPI 設備缺乏 PDE-based MACO 計算，使用舊版 1/1000 日劑量方法且無充分科學依據
blocks.en: HPAPI equipment lacks a PDE-based MACO calculation, using the old 1/1000 daily dose approach without sufficient scientific justification

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 在同一台配液槽上先後生產 Product A（PDE = 5 mg/day）和 Product B（最小批量 50 kg，最大日劑量 200 mg）。請計算 MACO 值，並說明需要什麼取樣策略來驗證清潔是否有效。
blocks.en: A CDMO manufactures Product A (PDE = 5 mg/day) and then Product B (minimum batch size 50 kg, maximum daily dose 200 mg) in the same compounding tank. Calculate the MACO value and explain what sampling strategy is needed to verify that cleaning is effective.

blocks.zh: 清潔 SOP 中規定「清潔後設備存放有效期為 72 小時」。某週末因設備故障，清潔後已存放 96 小時。生產工程師提議直接使用並在批次記錄中注記。這是否可接受？依據 §211.67 應如何正確處理？
blocks.en: The cleaning SOP specifies a post-cleaning equipment hold time of 72 hours. Over a weekend, because of an equipment failure, the cleaned equipment has been held for 96 hours. The production engineer proposes using it directly and adding a note in the batch record. Is this acceptable? How should it be handled correctly under §211.67?

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）：§211.67 的科學延伸
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation: The Scientific Extension of §211.67

blocks.zh: §211.67 要求清潔「防止污染」——FDA 期望製藥公司通過清潔驗證來科學証明清潔程序有效。清潔驗證的核心三步驟：
blocks.en: §211.67 requires cleaning to "prevent contamination" - FDA expects pharmaceutical companies to demonstrate scientifically, through cleaning validation, that the cleaning procedure is effective. The three core steps of cleaning validation are:

blocks.zh: 第一步：建立殘留限度（Acceptance Criteria）
blocks.en: Step 1: Establish residue limits (Acceptance Criteria)

blocks.zh: 最廣泛使用的方法是基於 PDE（Permitted Daily Exposure）的 MACO 計算：
blocks.en: The most widely used approach is the MACO calculation based on the PDE (Permitted Daily Exposure):

blocks.zh: MACO 公式（基於 PDE，依據 EMA 2014 指南）：
blocks.en: MACO formula (PDE-based, per the EMA 2014 guideline):

blocks.zh: MACO (mg/設備) = PDE (mg/day) × MBS (mg) ÷ MDD (mg/day)
blocks.en: MACO (mg/equipment) = PDE (mg/day) × MBS (mg) ÷ MDD (mg/day)

blocks.zh: 其中：PDE = 允許每日暴露量（由毒理學家依藥物安全數據計算）；MBS = 後續產品最小批量；MDD = 後續產品最大日劑量
blocks.en: Where: PDE = Permitted Daily Exposure (calculated by a toxicologist from the drug's safety data); MBS = minimum batch size of the following product; MDD = maximum daily dose of the following product

blocks.zh: 面積限度（µg/cm²）= MACO ÷ 共用設備接觸面積
blocks.en: Surface limit (µg/cm²) = MACO ÷ shared equipment contact surface area

blocks.zh: 第二步：建立取樣和分析方法
blocks.en: Step 2: Establish sampling and analytical methods

blocks.zh: 第三步：執行驗證（通常 3 次連續成功清潔）並建立持續監測
blocks.en: Step 3: Execute validation (typically 3 consecutive successful cleanings) and establish ongoing monitoring

blocks.zh: Clean Hold Time 與 Dirty Hold Time：§211.67(a) 的時間維度
blocks.en: Clean Hold Time and Dirty Hold Time: The Time Dimension of §211.67(a)

blocks.zh: §211.67(a) 要求「在適當時間間隔（at appropriate intervals）」清潔——這涉及兩個關鍵的時間限度，均需要驗證支持：
blocks.en: §211.67(a) requires cleaning "at appropriate intervals" - this involves two critical time limits, both of which need validation support:

blocks.zh: 實務範例： 一台配液槽的 DHT 驗證設計為 48 小時（模擬週末停產後的殘留狀態），CHT 驗證為 72 小時（清潔後最長存放時間）。如果實際生產中超過這些限度，需要在使用前重新清潔，並評估是否需要重新驗證。
blocks.en: Practical example: For a compounding tank, the DHT validation is designed at 48 hours (simulating the residue state after a weekend shutdown), and the CHT validation at 72 hours (the maximum post-cleaning hold time). If actual production exceeds these limits, the equipment must be re-cleaned before use, and the need for revalidation must be assessed.

blocks.zh: Campaign Manufacturing（連續多批次生產）的清潔管理
blocks.en: Cleaning Management in Campaign Manufacturing (Consecutive Batch Production)

blocks.zh: §211.67(a) 要求「在適當時間間隔清潔」——在 Campaign Manufacturing（連續生產同一產品多個批次而不在批次間清潔）情境下，此要求的解讀如下：
blocks.en: §211.67(a) requires cleaning "at appropriate intervals" - in Campaign Manufacturing (producing multiple batches of the same product consecutively without cleaning between batches), this requirement is interpreted as follows:

blocks.zh: Campaign 清潔驗證的關鍵問題： 在最大允許 Campaign 批次後，設備上的殘留是否仍在 MACO 限度內？微生物污染是否受控？Campaign 期間的 DHT 如何定義（每批結束還是整個 Campaign 結束）？
blocks.en: Key questions for campaign cleaning validation: After the maximum permitted campaign length, are the residues on the equipment still within the MACO limit? Is microbial contamination under control? How is the DHT defined during the campaign (at the end of each batch or at the end of the whole campaign)?

blocks.zh: HPAPI 的特殊考量： 對於高效能活性藥品原料（HPAPI，職業暴露限度 OEL ≤ 10 µg/m³），PDE 通常以 ng/day 計算，MACO 值極低。這類產品通常需要：
blocks.en: Special considerations for HPAPI: For highly potent active pharmaceutical ingredients (HPAPI, occupational exposure limit OEL ≤ 10 µg/m³), the PDE is usually expressed in ng/day and the MACO value is extremely low. Such products typically require:

blocks.zh: 指定/專用設備（Dedicated Equipment）——避免共用，避免清潔驗證挑戰
blocks.en: Designated/dedicated equipment - avoiding sharing and thereby avoiding cleaning validation challenges

blocks.zh: 如必須共用，需要最高靈敏度的分析方法（LC-MS/MS，檢測限至 ng/cm² 等級）
blocks.en: If sharing is unavoidable, analytical methods with the highest sensitivity (LC-MS/MS, with detection limits down to the ng/cm² level)

blocks.zh: FDA 和 EMA 均期望 HPAPI 使用 PDE 方法而非傳統 1/1000 日劑量方法
blocks.en: Both FDA and EMA expect the PDE approach for HPAPI rather than the traditional 1/1000 daily dose approach

blocks.zh: 2.5 §211.72 — Filters: The Sterilizing Filter Framework 2.5 §211.72 — 過濾器：滅菌過濾架構
blocks.en: 2.5 §211.72 — Filters: The Sterilizing Filter Framework

blocks.zh: 使用後完整性測試失敗：GMP 偏差處理流程
blocks.en: Post-Use Integrity Test Failure: GMP Deviation Handling Process

blocks.zh: 使用後（Post-use）完整性測試失敗是無菌批次的嚴重 GMP 事件，標準處理流程：
blocks.en: A post-use integrity test failure is a serious GMP event for an aseptic batch. The standard handling process is:

blocks.zh: 立即行動： 批次保留（Product Hold），啟動偏差調查（Deviation Investigation）
blocks.en: Immediate actions: Place the batch on hold (Product Hold) and start a deviation investigation (Deviation Investigation)

blocks.zh: 根本原因調查方向（RCA）：
blocks.en: Root cause investigation (RCA) directions:

blocks.zh: 使用前測試結果是否已通過？（如已通過，損壞發生在過濾過程中）
blocks.en: Did the pre-use test pass? (If so, the damage occurred during filtration)

blocks.zh: 過濾壓力是否超過驗證的最大壓力？（批次記錄 / 壓力記錄審查）
blocks.en: Did the filtration pressure exceed the validated maximum pressure? (Review the batch record / pressure records)

blocks.zh: 過濾介質是否超過驗證的最大使用時間？
blocks.en: Did the filter exceed the validated maximum use time?

blocks.zh: 產品的 pH、溶劑組成是否與驗證條件一致？（化學相容性）
blocks.en: Are the product pH and solvent composition consistent with the validated conditions? (Chemical compatibility)

blocks.zh: 安裝程序是否正確執行？（人員資格確認）
blocks.en: Was the installation procedure performed correctly? (Personnel qualification check)

blocks.zh: 無菌性風險評估： 批次放行決策需基於整體風險評估——過濾是唯一的無菌化步驟，還是最終滅菌前的預備步驟？其他無菌保障措施（充氮、環境控制）的狀態如何？
blocks.en: Sterility risk assessment: The batch release decision must be based on an overall risk assessment - is filtration the only sterilization step, or a preliminary step before terminal sterilization? What is the status of other sterility assurance measures (nitrogen overlay, environmental control)?

blocks.zh: CAPA： 依調查根本原因制定預防措施，並評估是否需要重新驗證
blocks.en: CAPA: Establish preventive actions based on the root cause identified in the investigation, and assess whether revalidation is needed

blocks.zh: HEPA 完整性測試（DOP/PAO Leak Test）：空氣側的 §211.72 類比
blocks.en: HEPA Integrity Test (DOP/PAO Leak Test): The Air-Side Analogue of §211.72

blocks.zh: §211.72 針對液體過濾器；§211.42(c)(10)(iii) 針對 HEPA 空氣過濾。HEPA 完整性測試（通常稱為 DOP Test 或 PAO Test）是空氣側的類比：
blocks.en: §211.72 addresses liquid filters, while §211.42(c)(10)(iii) addresses HEPA air filtration. The HEPA integrity test (commonly called the DOP test or PAO test) is the air-side analogue:

blocks.zh: 方法： 在 HEPA 上游注入 PAO（聚 α-烯烴）氣溶膠，用光度計在下游掃描，檢測穿漏點
blocks.en: Method: Inject a PAO (polyalphaolefin) aerosol upstream of the HEPA filter and scan downstream with a photometer to detect leaks

blocks.zh: 合格標準： 下游濃度 ≤ 0.01% 上游濃度（per ISO 14644-3）
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: Downstream concentration ≤ 0.01% of upstream concentration (per ISO 14644-3)

blocks.zh: 測試頻率： 安裝後首次確認（IQ/OQ）；此後依據風險評估定期複測（通常每 6–12 個月）
blocks.en: Test frequency: Initial verification after installation (IQ/OQ); thereafter retested periodically based on risk assessment (typically every 6–12 months)

blocks.zh: 失敗處理： 找到穿漏點後，可嘗試修補（填充劑）或更換 HEPA；修補後必須重新通過完整性測試
blocks.en: Failure handling: After a leak is located, it may be repaired (with a sealant) or the HEPA filter replaced; after repair, the filter must pass the integrity test again

blocks.zh: 483 高頻觀察：§211.72 相關缺陷
blocks.en: High-Frequency 483 Observations: §211.72-Related Deficiencies

blocks.zh: 使用後完整性測試失敗但缺乏充分的偏差調查，僅記錄「更換過濾器」
blocks.en: Post-use integrity test failure without an adequate deviation investigation, with only "replaced filter" recorded

blocks.zh: 過濾器使用時間或過濾量超過驗證的最大限度
blocks.en: Filter use time or filtered volume exceeds the validated maximum

blocks.zh: 過濾器驗證未包含最差情況藥液濃度、pH 或溫度條件
blocks.en: Filter validation does not include worst-case drug solution concentration, pH or temperature conditions

blocks.zh: 完整性測試儀器（過濾器測試儀）未按 §211.68(a) 要求校準
blocks.en: The integrity test instrument (filter tester) is not calibrated as required by §211.68(a)

blocks.zh: 批次記錄中無過濾操作記錄條目（過濾器批號、使用前/後測試結果、測試人簽名）
blocks.en: The batch record has no filtration entries (filter lot number, pre-/post-use test results, tester signature)

blocks.zh: 使用前完整性測試未執行即直接使用（僅依賴使用後測試）
blocks.en: Filter used directly without a pre-use integrity test (relying on the post-use test alone)

blocks.zh: 一批注射用生理鹽水在使用後過濾器擴散流測試中，測得值 8 mL/min（供應商規格 ≤ 6 mL/min）。使用前測試通過（擴散流 4 mL/min）。請描述你的偏差調查方向和批次處置決策考量。
blocks.en: For a batch of normal saline for injection, the post-use filter diffusive flow test gave 8 mL/min (supplier specification ≤ 6 mL/min). The pre-use test passed (diffusive flow 4 mL/min). Describe your deviation investigation approach and the considerations for the batch disposition decision.

blocks.zh: §211.72 禁止石棉過濾器，但沒有直接要求 0.22 µm 過濾。那麼，無菌藥液必須通過 0.22 µm 除菌過濾的法規依據是什麼？請列出完整的法規鏈（至少涉及 3 個文件）。
blocks.en: §211.72 prohibits asbestos filters but does not directly require 0.22 µm filtration. So what is the regulatory basis for requiring sterile drug solutions to pass through a 0.22 µm sterilizing filter? List the complete regulatory chain (involving at least 3 documents).

blocks.zh: 一個配方開發團隊提議在現有的 0.22 µm 除菌過濾前加裝一個 0.45 µm 的預過濾器以延長 0.22 µm 過濾器的使用壽命。這需要什麼 GMP 評估？（提示：考慮驗證影響、記錄更新、Annex 1 雙層過濾考量）
blocks.en: A formulation development team proposes adding a 0.45 µm prefilter upstream of the existing 0.22 µm sterilizing filter to extend the 0.22 µm filter's service life. What GMP assessment is required? (Hint: consider the impact on validation, record updates, and the Annex 1 redundant filtration considerations)

blocks.zh: §211.72 與 0.22 µm 除菌過濾的完整法規鏈
blocks.en: The Complete Regulatory Chain for §211.72 and 0.22 µm Sterilizing Filtration

blocks.zh: §211.72 本身並不直接要求無菌製程必須使用 0.22 µm 除菌過濾——它規定「非釋放纖維」和「禁止石棉」。0.22 µm 過濾除菌的要求來自多層法規與標準的疊加：
blocks.en: §211.72 itself does not directly require aseptic processes to use 0.22 µm sterilizing filtration - it specifies "non-fiber-releasing" filters and prohibits asbestos. The 0.22 µm filtration requirement comes from the combination of multiple layers of regulations and standards:

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾器完整性測試：技術方法比較
blocks.en: Sterilizing Filter Integrity Testing: Comparison of Technical Methods

blocks.zh: FDA 無菌指南要求在使用前（Pre-use）和使用後（Post-use）對除菌過濾器進行完整性測試。三種主要方法：
blocks.en: The FDA Aseptic Guidance requires integrity testing of sterilizing filters before use (Pre-use) and after use (Post-use). The three main methods are:

blocks.zh: 注意： 每種過濾器的具體合格規格由製造商通過細菌挑戰測試（Bacterial Challenge Test, BCT）與完整性測試的相關性確認。使用者需採用製造商規定的測試條件和合格標準。
blocks.en: Note: The specific acceptance specification for each filter is confirmed by the manufacturer by correlating the Bacterial Challenge Test (BCT) with integrity testing. Users must apply the test conditions and acceptance criteria specified by the manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 雙層除菌過濾（Redundant / Tandem Filtration）
blocks.en: Redundant / Tandem Filtration

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) §8.86 建議考慮雙層除菌過濾（串聯兩個 0.22 µm 過濾器），特別是對不能最終滅菌的產品。FDA 指南中無強制要求，但對高風險產品（蛋白質生物製劑、特殊緩衝液）查廠時可能詢問是否評估過此選項。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) §8.86 recommends considering redundant sterilizing filtration (two 0.22 µm filters in series), particularly for products that cannot be terminally sterilized. It is not mandatory in FDA guidance, but for high-risk products (protein biologics, special buffers) inspectors may ask whether this option has been evaluated.

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾器驗證（Filter Validation）：§211.72 的科學支撐
blocks.en: Sterilizing Filter Validation: The Scientific Support for §211.72

blocks.zh: §211.72 要求過濾器「非釋放纖維」——FDA 進一步期望製造商驗證過濾器適用於特定產品和製程。除菌過濾器驗證通常包括：
blocks.en: §211.72 requires filters to be "non-fiber-releasing" - FDA further expects manufacturers to validate that the filter is suitable for the specific product and process. Sterilizing filter validation typically includes:

blocks.zh: 重要原則： 過濾器驗證是製造商自行完成的應用驗證，而非購買過濾器時廠商提供的證書（廠商提供的是通用型 BCT，不能直接替代特定產品的應用驗證）。FDA 查廠時會要求查看過濾器驗證報告。
blocks.en: Key principle: Filter validation is an application-specific validation performed by the manufacturer itself, not the certificate supplied by the vendor when a filter is purchased (the vendor provides a generic BCT, which cannot directly replace product-specific application validation). During inspections FDA will ask to see the filter validation report.

blocks.zh: 連結 §211.42(c)(10)(iii)：液體過濾與空氣過濾的雙重框架
blocks.en: Link to §211.42(c)(10)(iii): The Dual Framework of Liquid Filtration and Air Filtration

blocks.zh: 無菌製程中，§211.72（液體過濾）與 §211.42(c)(10)(iii)（HEPA 空氣過濾）共同構成一個雙重屏障系統：
blocks.en: In aseptic processing, §211.72 (liquid filtration) and §211.42(c)(10)(iii) (HEPA air filtration) together form a dual barrier system:

blocks.zh: 這兩種過濾器的「完整性失效」對批次的影響截然不同：HEPA 洩漏通常不立即危及當前批次（需評估環境監測數據），而除菌過濾器使用後完整性失敗直接威脅批次的無菌性——需要嚴格偏差調查和批次處置決策。
blocks.en: The "integrity failure" of these two types of filter has very different consequences for the batch: a HEPA leak does not usually endanger the current batch immediately (environmental monitoring data must be assessed), whereas a post-use integrity failure of a sterilizing filter directly threatens batch sterility - requiring a rigorous deviation investigation and batch disposition decision.

blocks.zh: 2.6 §§211.44–211.56 — Supporting Facility Requirements: Lighting, Plumbing, Sanitation & Maintenance 2.6 §§211.44–211.56 — 廠房輔助設施要求：照明、管路、衛生與維護
blocks.en: 2.6 §§211.44–211.56 — Supporting Facility Requirements: Lighting, Plumbing, Sanitation & Maintenance

blocks.zh: §211.44 照明：細節中的 GMP 意涵
blocks.en: §211.44 Lighting: GMP Implications in the Details

blocks.zh: §211.44 僅一句話「充足照明」，但在注射劑目視檢查操作中具有重要意義：
blocks.en: §211.44 is only one sentence ("adequate lighting"), but it is important for visual inspection operations on injectables:

blocks.zh: 目視檢查（Visual Inspection, VI）： USP <790> 和 <1790> 規定充填液目視檢查的照明強度標準（通常 2000–3750 lux）。§211.44 是其 CGMP 法規依據。
blocks.en: Visual Inspection (VI): USP <790> and <1790> specify lighting intensity standards for visual inspection of filled containers (typically 2000–3750 lux). §211.44 is the CGMP regulatory basis for this.

blocks.zh: 標籤核對： 照明不足可能導致標籤辨識錯誤，引發 §211.42(b) 的 mix-up 問題。
blocks.en: Label verification: Inadequate lighting can lead to label misidentification, causing mix-up problems under §211.42(b).

blocks.zh: FDA 483 案例： 部分警告信引用「目視檢查工作站照明不足」為缺陷，連結 §211.44。
blocks.en: FDA 483 cases: Some Warning Letters have cited "inadequate lighting at visual inspection workstations" as a deficiency, linked to §211.44.

blocks.zh: §211.54/56 衛生與維護：書面程序要求
blocks.en: §211.54/56 Sanitation and Maintenance: Written Procedure Requirements

blocks.zh: §211.56(c)(d) 明確要求衛生清潔程序的書面化，包括：使用時間表、清潔步驟詳細描述、具體清潔劑和工具、廢料處理方式，以及合規記錄。這些要求與 §211.67（設備清潔）在「書面程序 + 記錄」的框架上完全一致，共同構成 CGMP 清潔管理體系的法規基礎。
blocks.en: §211.56(c)(d) explicitly requires sanitation procedures to be written, including: schedules for use, detailed description of cleaning steps, specific cleaning agents and tools, methods of waste disposal, and records of compliance. These requirements are fully consistent with §211.67 (equipment cleaning) in the "written procedure + records" framework, and together they form the regulatory basis of the CGMP cleaning management system.

blocks.zh: 害蟲防治（Pest Control）— §211.54 的重要子主題
blocks.en: Pest Control - An Important Sub-Topic of §211.54

blocks.zh: §211.54 要求廠房免於鼠類、鳥類、昆蟲等害蟲侵擾。常見 483 觀察：
blocks.en: §211.54 requires that facilities be free of infestation by rodents, birds, insects and other pests. Common 483 observations:

blocks.zh: 倉庫門底部有縫隙，未安裝擋鼠板
blocks.en: Gaps under warehouse doors, with no rodent guards installed

blocks.zh: 害蟲誘捕站設置不足或記錄不完整
blocks.en: Insufficient pest trap stations or incomplete records

blocks.zh: 在倉庫或生產走廊發現鼠類活動跡象（糞便、嚙咬痕跡）
blocks.en: Signs of rodent activity (droppings, gnaw marks) found in the warehouse or production corridors

blocks.zh: 外部承包商（害蟲防治）的服務記錄缺失
blocks.en: Service records of the external pest control contractor are missing

blocks.zh: §211.48 管路系統：注射用水（WFI）的連結
blocks.en: §211.48 Plumbing: The Link to Water for Injection (WFI)

blocks.zh: §211.48 要求飲用水符合 EPA 標準——這是最低要求。對於注射劑製造，實際水質標準遠高於此：
blocks.en: §211.48 requires potable water to meet EPA standards - this is the minimum requirement. For injectable manufacturing, the actual water quality standards are far higher:

blocks.zh: §211.48 是建立水系統 GMP 合規性的起始法規。WFI 的要求來自 §211.67（設備清潔）、藥典標準和 FDA 無菌指南的組合。
blocks.en: §211.48 is the starting regulation for establishing GMP compliance of water systems. The WFI requirements come from a combination of §211.67 (equipment cleaning), pharmacopoeial standards and the FDA Aseptic Guidance.

blocks.zh: 2.7 §211.68 — Automatic, Mechanical, and Electronic Equipment 2.7 §211.68 — 自動化、機械與電子設備
blocks.en: 2.7 §211.68 — Automatic, Mechanical, and Electronic Equipment

blocks.zh: §211.68(a) 校準計劃：關鍵儀表的 GMP 管理
blocks.en: §211.68(a) Calibration Program: GMP Control of Critical Instruments

blocks.zh: 對無菌注射劑廠房，需納入書面校準計劃的關鍵儀表包括：
blocks.en: For a sterile injectable facility, critical instruments that must be included in the written calibration program include:

blocks.zh: 壓差計（Magnehelic / 電子差壓計）——§211.46(b) 正壓監控
blocks.en: Differential pressure gauges (Magnehelic / electronic differential pressure gauges) - positive pressure monitoring under §211.46(b)

blocks.zh: 溫濕度感測器（溫度記錄器 / 資料記錄器）
blocks.en: Temperature and humidity sensors (temperature recorders / data loggers)

blocks.zh: 滅菌釜溫度探針（F₀ 計算依賴精準溫度測量）
blocks.en: Autoclave temperature probes (F₀ calculation depends on accurate temperature measurement)

blocks.zh: HPLC 系統（分析天平、UV 偵測器、進樣閥）
blocks.en: HPLC systems (analytical balance, UV detector, injection valve)

blocks.zh: 灌裝機稱重系統（在線重量檢查）
blocks.en: Filling machine weighing system (in-line weight check)

blocks.zh: 過濾器完整性測試儀（連結 §211.72 的合規性）
blocks.en: Filter integrity tester (linked to §211.72 compliance)

blocks.zh: 校準標準通常追溯至 NIST（美國國家標準技術研究院）或同等國家計量標準，並保留可追溯性文件。
blocks.en: Calibration standards are normally traceable to NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology) or an equivalent national metrology standard, with traceability documentation retained.

blocks.zh: §211.68 與 21 CFR Part 11 的關係
blocks.en: §211.68 and 21 CFR Part 11

blocks.zh: §211.68 是設備控制和電腦化系統的 CGMP 物理要求，21 CFR Part 11 是電子記錄和電子簽名的記錄管理要求。兩者互補：
blocks.en: §211.68 is the CGMP requirement for the physical control of equipment and computerized systems, while 21 CFR Part 11 is the requirement for managing electronic records and electronic signatures. The two are complementary:

blocks.zh: 在實際合規中，§211.68 + Part 11 + ISPE GAMP 5 共同構成電腦化系統驗證（CSV）的三層架構。
blocks.en: In practice, §211.68 + Part 11 + ISPE GAMP 5 together form the three-layer framework for computerized system validation (CSV).

blocks.zh: 2.8 Subparts C–D 跨條款整合：從法規到實務的連結地圖
blocks.en: 2.8 Cross-Provision Integration of Subparts C–D: A Map from Regulation to Practice
